titulo: The head tilt at the crooked frame
caption:
The head tilt at the crooked frame

My roommate tilts her head every time she passes the crooked frame. Then I straightened it.

A frame that hangs a little off keeps tugging at the eye, and one nudge is usually all it takes.

For whoever fixes the small crooked thing on the way past.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice and no text, with music. A bedroom with a bed and an empty picture frame on the wall, hanging tilted. A plum figure on the right looks up at it with narrowed eyes and tilts its head, twice. A ink-black block figure with white eyes walks over, stretches up, and the frame swings level with a small knock. Both figures turn happy with a pulse.
